global using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using KingZon.OLCM.Base.Shared.DataBase.Entities;
using KingZon.OLCM.Common.DataBase.Entities;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Diagnostics;
using System.Data.Common;

public abstract class TestEntity
{
    public long Id { get; set; }
    public bool IsDeleted { get; set; }
}

namespace KingZon.Core.Web { public class KingZonControllerBase : ControllerBase { } }
namespace KingZon.Core.DataBase { public enum SystemParaType { 财务结算日期 } }
namespace KingZon.OLCM.Common.DataBase.Enum { public enum SaleOrderStatus { 待下单, 进行中, 已完成 } }
namespace KingZon.OLCM.Base.Shared.DataBase.Entities
{
    public class Base_Category : TestEntity { public string Name { get; set; } = ""; }
    public class Base_Partner : TestEntity
    {
        public long? CategoryId { get; set; }
        public Base_Category? Category { get; set; }
        public string Name { get; set; } = "";
        [System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema.NotMapped]
        public string CustomerName { get => Name; set => Name = value; }
    }
}
namespace KingZon.OLCM.Common.DataBase.Entities
{
    public class SaleOrder : TestEntity
    {
        public string OrderNo { get; set; } = "SO";
        public string? CustomerOrderNo { get; set; }
        public string? Remark { get; set; }
        public long CustomerId { get; set; }
        public Base_Partner Customer { get; set; } = null!;
        public DateTime CreateTime { get; set; }
        public decimal OrderTotalPrice { get; set; }
        public decimal OrderTotalPriceHaveTax { get; set; }
        public KingZon.OLCM.Common.DataBase.Enum.SaleOrderStatus Status { get; set; }
    }
    public class SaleOrderDetail : TestEntity
    {
        public long SaleOrderId { get; set; }
        public long? HistoryProductId { get; set; }
        public string? CustomerMaterialNo { get; set; }
        public int PlaceOrderQuantity { get; set; }
        public decimal Price { get; set; }
        public decimal PriceHaveTax { get; set; }
        public decimal TotalPrice { get; set; }
        public decimal TotalPriceHaveTax { get; set; }
        public decimal MoldCost { get; set; }
        public string? Remark { get; set; }
    }
    public class HistoryProduct : TestEntity
    {
        public string ProductNo { get; set; } = "";
        public string ProductName { get; set; } = "";
        public string? CustomerMaterialNo { get; set; }
        public string? Specification { get; set; }
        public string? Version { get; set; }
        public string Unit { get; set; } = "PCS";
    }
    public class DeliveryOrder : TestEntity
    {
        public string OrderNo { get; set; } = "DO";
        public long CustomerId { get; set; }
        public Base_Partner Customer { get; set; } = null!;
        public DateTime DeliveryTime { get; set; }
    }
    public class DeliveryOrderDetail : TestEntity
    {
        public long SaleOrderDetailId { get; set; }
        public long HistoryProductId { get; set; }
        public string DetailNo { get; set; } = "";
        public string? Remark { get; set; }
        public long? DeliveryOrderId { get; set; }
        public bool IsOutboundInventory { get; set; }
        public decimal SalePrice { get; set; }
        public int DeliveryQuantity { get; set; }
        public int ReturnQuantity { get; set; }
    }
    public class SaleReturnOrder : TestEntity
    {
        public long CustomerId { get; set; }
        public DateTime ReturnTime { get; set; }
        public decimal OrderTotalPrice { get; set; }
        public decimal OrderTotalPriceHaveTax { get; set; }
    }
}
namespace Kingzon.OLCM.Common.Services
{
    public class SystemParaService
    {
        public int FinanceDate { get; set; } = 26;
        public List<SystemParaInfo> GetSystermParaByTypesAndCode(List<KingZon.Core.DataBase.SystemParaType> types, string? code)
            => [new SystemParaInfo { SystemPara = new SystemParaValue { DataValue = FinanceDate.ToString() } }];
        public class SystemParaInfo { public SystemParaValue SystemPara { get; set; } = new(); }
        public class SystemParaValue { public string DataValue { get; set; } = "26"; }
    }
    public class CommonService<T>(ReportDb db) where T : TestEntity
    {
        public IQueryable<T> GetAll(bool includeDeleted = false) => includeDeleted ? db.Set<T>() : db.Set<T>().Where(x => !x.IsDeleted);
    }
}
public class ReportDb(DbContextOptions<ReportDb> options) : DbContext(options)
{
    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder model)
    {
        model.Entity<Base_Partner>().HasOne(x => x.Category).WithMany().HasForeignKey(x => x.CategoryId);
        model.Entity<SaleOrder>();
        model.Entity<SaleOrderDetail>();
        model.Entity<HistoryProduct>();
        model.Entity<DeliveryOrder>();
        model.Entity<DeliveryOrderDetail>();
        model.Entity<SaleReturnOrder>();
    }
}
public class QueryCounter : DbCommandInterceptor
{
    public int Count { get; set; }
    public override ValueTask<InterceptionResult<DbDataReader>> ReaderExecutingAsync(DbCommand command, CommandEventData eventData, InterceptionResult<DbDataReader> result, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        Count++;
        return ValueTask.FromResult(result);
    }
}
